calls.statement:
SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) n_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) n_rl, sum(f.quantity) units, min(f.quantity) minq, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) hel_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at,
 (SELECT sum(r.quantity_returned) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id) ret_q
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND f.sale_ts_utc BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2026-09-26' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-10-06'
ORDER BY f.sale_ts_utc

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, r.business_date, r.receipts, r.units_sold, r.net_sales_before_returns, (SELECT count(DISTINCT receipt_id) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND f.sale_date=d.calendar_date) my_receipts, (SELECT sum(quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=131 AND f.sale_date=d.calendar_date AND p.category<>'ZZ Test') my_units
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=131
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' ORDER BY 1
